name: Zapped Giants
summary: On Feralas's Forgotten Coast, Zorbin Fandazzle tests a shrinking ray on the giants near the docks. He built it from a gnomish design and improved it with goblin know-how, then gives you the Ultra-Shrinker to try on Feralas's giants.

sections.title: A Shrinking Ray for the Giants
sections.body:
Zorbin Fandazzle needs the giants of Feralas dealt with so he can stay and keep his business. His answer is a shrinking ray based on a gnomish design, improved with what he calls superior goblin advances. He would rather you test it than risk his own life.

Use the Ultra-Shrinker on Cliff Giants, Deep Striders, Wave Striders, Shore Striders or Land Walkers. Gather the miniaturization residue left behind when they shrink, then bring it back to the docks.

sections.title: Why Zorbin Wants the Residue
sections.body: Zorbin calls miniaturization residue valuable in engineering. It helps keep a zapper from exploding on its user. Then he adds that this applies only to other zappers, not the one in your hands.

sections.title: Back at the Docks
sections.body: Zorbin is delighted when you return with the residue and all your major appendages intact. He insists the Ultra-Shrinker was never risky and calls you a friend to goblins everywhere.

faq.answer: Zorbin Fandazzle built the Ultra-Shrinker by the docks on Feralas's Forgotten Coast.

faq.q: Why does Zorbin want the giants shrunk?
faq.answer: Zorbin says the giants are bad for business if he is to stay there. Shrunken giants are far more manageable.
Any kind of giant in Feralas will do. Along the Forgotten Coast, you can find Cliff Giants, Deep Striders, Wave Striders, Shore Striders and Land Walkers.
Miniaturization residue is left on a giant after it shrinks. Zorbin calls it valuable in engineering because it helps keep a zapper from exploding on its user.
